semantics.scope: files each epic creates (N) or modifies (P); baseline (B) references are shared inputs, not owned
semantics.uniqueOwnerPerWave: one writer -> SOLE; writers in strictly distinct waves -> SEQUENTIAL (allowed); two writers in the same wave -> CONFLICT, PENDING_MAINTAINER_ADJUDICATION, no writer silently dropped; a same-wave double-write on a canonical-owner file with a valid maintainer-approved write sequence (Q4(a)) -> SERIALIZED, and every same-wave adjacent pair must carry an explicit predecessor edge
